noCodes: No public class-location code list: the Registrar's glossary (https://registrar.dartmouth.edu/students/systems-tools-forms/glossary-dartmouth-terminology) has none, the campus map's Dartmouth Buildings layer (https://services1.arcgis.com/ajkPMiuiqxF9xEgP/arcgis/rest/services/Dartmouth_Buildings/FeatureServer/23) gives names and addresses only, and the Planon property layer (Planon_Identification_Map_WFL1) carries facilities property codes with cost centres, not a published class-location list; checked 2026-11-07.
